blocks.title: Legal ramifications
blocks.text: Violating terms of use can lead to serious legal consequences: users can be fined, sued or banned from the service.

Using software without a proper licence can lead to legal action for piracy, and companies using unlicensed software also face cybersecurity risks. Fraud or unauthorized transactions through a digital payment service such as PayPak can bring fines or criminal charges.
